title: $1,000 in Netflix in 2002 is now worth this
caption:
In 2002, Netflix was mailing DVDs.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:NFLX:2002-05-23} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Netflix in 2002? 👇
sources: Netflix price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:NFLX:2002-05-23}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
